waiting.title: The residents want it fixed
waiting.text: Teodor Petrova is back for the residents. "The homes themselves (bunk dorms are cramped; studios, flats and suites roomy), still. It's costing us 5.6 points of happiness. Roomier homes: studios, flats or suites rather than bunk dorms. Will you do something about it?"

outcomes: The lava tube on floor 3 is open: free space to build in, no digging required.
A toast to the first child born on Mars.
A festival for five floors down! Lanterns are going up the shaft.
The Hygiea Star came down on our pad: six belters, safe, and their salvage. Everyone turned out to see, and somebody brought snacks.
